name: Thymosin Alpha-1
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Thymosin Alpha-1 (TA) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Thymosin Alpha-1 tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each TA lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 62304-98-7, formula C129H215N33O55, 3108.3 Da).

faq.question: How should Thymosin Alpha-1 be stored?
faq.answer: Thymosin Alpha-1 ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Thymosin Alpha-1?
faq.answer: Thymosin Alpha-1 is stocked in 2 pack sizes (5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $102.36; 10–49 kits falls to $94.18 (−8%) and 50+ to $87.00 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
